status: proposed declarative contract specification not implementation
formatNotice: This catalog documents proposed records, field types and invariants. It is not executable JSON Schema, generated C# code, a serialization contract already in service, or proof of implementation.

domainBoundary.engineIndependence: No Unity, Godot, renderer, scene-tree, asset-loader or UI object references in domain records.
domainBoundary.idPolicy: Use distinct Guid-backed readonly record structs such as HorseId, BreedingCommitId, SaveId and OwnerId; never substitute a display name for an identity.
domainBoundary.catalogIdPolicy: Use distinct stable string-backed IDs for variants, loci, regions, synthetic markers, traits, materials and mesh families. Versions are explicit value objects.
domainBoundary.collectionPolicy: Use immutable collections or defensive snapshots. IReadOnlyList alone does not guarantee immutability if mutable storage remains aliased.
domainBoundary.numericPolicy: Use exact rational probabilities for enumerated outcomes. Use a documented estimate type for sampled results. Prefer quantized domain values for replay-sensitive trait calculations; the implementation must define rounding and overflow behavior.
domainBoundary.hashPolicy: ContentHash means a hash of a future documented canonical representation, not a hash of incidental JSON property order or a mutable object reference.
domainBoundary.syntheticMarkerNotice: All synthetic marker identities, effect sizes, dominance terms, tradeoffs and aptitude predictions are game parameters, not established equine genes or real-world performance tests.

mutabilityVocabulary.immutableAtCreation: Set when the authoritative record is created; only an explicit versioned migration can replace it.
mutabilityVocabulary.immutableAtConception: Set as part of a committed reproduction event and never rerolled.
mutabilityVocabulary.appendOnce: Absent until the relevant event; recorded once and preserved.
mutabilityVocabulary.appendOnly: New historical events may be appended; existing events cannot be rewritten by routine play.
mutabilityVocabulary.mutable: May change through an authorized domain command without changing horse identity or ancestry.
mutabilityVocabulary.derivedSnapshot: A pure, reproducible value derived from identified inputs and versioned rules.
mutabilityVocabulary.mutableValidated: May change only through a validated domain command that preserves the record invariants and legal state transitions.

fields.name: albumReferences

fields.name: playerKnowledge

fields.name: revision

invariants: The genome, parentage, appearanceSeed, developmentalFactors and resolverVersion are fixed at conception for bred horses and at creation for founders.
Training, naming, cosmetics, ownership and life-state changes cannot edit inherited alleles.
An explicit migration is the only route to replacing immutable versioned fields; it must preserve provenance and define treatment of existing appearance.
Color rarity, generation count, trophies and purchased status confer no automatic inherited performance bonus.
A complete pedigree graph is retained independently of how many generations the UI displays.
Care or health mode changes cannot silently alter genotype or Mendelian outcome probabilities.

The catalog distinguishes a variant, a haplotype, a phenotype name and a breed identity.
Unsupported combinations remain deferred instead of being assigned improvised viability or visual rules.

Gray changes presentation with visual age without erasing base genotype.
White patterning masks visible pigment without deleting obscured alleles.
The phenotype never includes training XP or player cosmetics as biological inheritance.
The resolver has no global RNG consumption, engine object access, external model call or network dependency.

The core inherited recipe is independent of cosmetic RNG and cosmetic state.
Visual asset migration preserves approved identity or provides an explicit documented migration policy.
No scene code independently chooses a coat class from a breed name or color label.

fields.name: inheritanceModelVersion

fields.name: offspringResolverVersion

fields.name: coatOutcomes

fields.name: gamePotentialForecast
fields.purpose: Estimated inherited game aptitude distribution, not guaranteed developed skill or a real-world DNA test.

fields.name: diversityReport

fields.name: compatibilityReport
fields.purpose: Disclosed eligibility, required tests and policy decisions.

fields.name: careCommitment

fields.name: probabilityMethod
fields.purpose: exactEnumeration, sampledEstimate or conditionalBounds.

fields.name: forecastSamplerVersion

fields.name: sampleCount
fields.purpose: Required for sampled estimates.

fields.name: inputHash
fields.purpose: All inputs, assumptions and versions used to detect stale forecasts.

fields.name: commitEligibility

invariants: Forecasting never consumes or advances the authoritative breeding RNG stream.
Known-genotype simple crosses use exact probabilities; sampled results disclose their uncertainty.
A normal knowledge-limited forecast cannot silently read hidden actual alleles.
A hypothetical scenario is labeled scenarioOnly and cannot be passed directly into a breeding commit.
Possible visible coats are not a promise of an exact future individual marking layout.
Mode changes do not bias Mendelian results toward desirable foals.
Eligibility and resource state are revalidated when a candidate command is committed.
If health compatibility requires genotype information, request or perform the designed disclosed test; do not accidentally reveal hidden genotype through an unexplained verdict.

invariants: One authoritative breeding stream supplies the reproduction event seed; other game systems cannot consume that stream.
Costs, parent eligibility, reservations, new horse record, reproduction event and RNG advancement succeed or fail together.
A failed command does not debit funds, reserve space or consume a breeding result.
Birth animation, naming, save/reload, menus and later cosmetic choices cannot change this event.
Every offspring allele traces to its recorded parent gamete unless a separately supported and explicitly recorded mutation feature exists.
Known nonviable pairings included in the game are handled before commitment; never filter or secretly reroll an already sampled offspring while retaining unconditioned odds.
Replicating the record replays an existing horse; it does not create a second horse or a second debit.
Hypothetical-scenario or omniscient-sandbox records cannot enter a normal save as ordinary committed outcomes.

rngStreamContract.breeding: Consumed only by successful BreedingCommit transactions; each event derives its gametes and fixed foal factors with documented purpose labels.
rngStreamContract.world: NPC/world generation and events; newly generated horse records are fixed once created.
rngStreamContract.competition: Event conditions and permitted performance variation; never reproduction.
rngStreamContract.forecast: Not a persisted authoritative stream; use exact enumeration or a deterministic local sampler keyed by forecast inputs and samplerVersion.

invariants: Loading a save never globally upgrades every existing horse to the newest resolver.
Missing legacy rules/assets produce an explicit migration or load decision, not a silent recolor.
Save writing preserves a recoverable prior snapshot and validates cross-record references before replacing it.
Pending pregnancies keep their committed genotype, seeds and original scheduled timing unless an explicit calendar migration documents a different schedule.
Sandbox knowledge, money or generated genotypes are not silently imported into Standard or Relaxed progression.

invariants: Manual inputs affect the event; no hidden preselected winner.
Ride, watched AI and delegated modes use shared course, horse, eligibility and reward rules.
A replay consumes frozen participant/event state and recorded controls, never current mutable HorseRecord values.
Training, recovery, cosmetic edits or later content changes cannot rewrite a historical result.
Results settle once by entry/result identity; accelerated resolution must match the agreed authoritative tick model.
Snapshot formation and entry-cost/workload reservation are atomic.

invariants: No breeding or subleasing rights; player remains owner.
No simultaneous player competitions, local service income, training or stud service.
Ordinary lessee care does not duplicate home feed charges; ordinary home fixed overhead remains unless independently changed.
Default duration is seven game days, never real-time waiting.
Once-only payment occurs at End Day for completed service days, including the recall boundary according to a documented day-boundary convention.
Return never forces sale or deletes a horse; cooperative care is a guaranteed fallback.
Contract start, horse availability and return-capacity forecasting are validated atomically.

modeScenariosAndPotential.status: Proposed behavior requiring implementation and playtesting
modeScenariosAndPotential.standardAndRelaxed: Calendar speed and economic pressure may differ. Supported biological inheritance, actual parent genotype, and committed offspring genotype do not gain favorable odds.
modeScenariosAndPotential.hypotheticalScenario: Players may propose alleles and compare possible outcomes without editing actual horses. The UI labels every assumption and the result is not commit eligible.
modeScenariosAndPotential.omniscientSandbox: A separate sandbox save may reveal the actual simulated genotype and inherited game potential for experimentation. This is not evidence of a real horse genetic test or a normal progression forecast.
modeScenariosAndPotential.candidatePairForecast: Uses currently revealed knowledge and explicit priors/bounds. The actual commit uses authoritative parent genomes after disclosed eligibility checks.
modeScenariosAndPotential.actualSimulatedPotential: The engine may know a fixed bounded game-potential vector. Normal play estimates it through tests designed for the game, observations or development; no real-world predictive precision is claimed.
modeScenariosAndPotential.developedAbility: Training, bond, condition, facilities and player/NPC riding express potential in activities. Parents do not transmit their accumulated training.
modeScenariosAndPotential.potentialTradeoffs: Specialization, bounded effects and discipline demand are designed game mechanics. Color, generation and purchase/adoption route do not add power.

reviewGates: Agree exact supported biological haplotypes and evidence before implementing their inheritance rules.
Select the final synthetic marker count/effects and mark every coefficient as fictional game data.
Implement pure core functions and meaningful fixtures before connecting the rendering engine.
Prove knowledge-limited forecasts cannot accidentally leak actual hidden parent genomes.
Prove save/reload, failed transactions and cosmetic/world actions cannot reroll a committed foal.
Verify every UI and venue renders the same horse from the shared phenotype and visual descriptor.
Review explicit version migrations against a preserved collection of old horse records and render recipes.
